{{Top|leg}}
The '''Droid sonic sensors Type 2''' were devices that aided a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] in the detection of intruders hidden or visually camouflaged by means other than [[Stealth field generator/Legends|stealth fields]]. These sensors were an advanced version of the [[Droid sonic sensors Type 1|Type 1]], therefore the background noise filtering was better and detection capabilities were increased.

==Behind the scenes==
A droid must be at upgrade class 2 to be able to equip this item.
